blockers.detail: Measurement m1 is recorded with units 'seconds' (value 0.012) while the claim metric and published value use milliseconds (12 ms). Previous feedback prohibits silent relabeling or manufactured conversion. No documented, versioned unit conversion record has been supplied to reconcile this mismatch.
blockers.required_input: A controller-supplied, versioned unit conversion record or a re-recorded measurement with confirmed units of milliseconds for m1/run-1, plus a controller_numeric_check using the exact recorded cells, units, and original criterion.

input.reason: The claim states completion time is 12 ms under configuration A. The published value is 12 ms. Measurement m1 from run-1 is recorded as 0.012 with units labeled "seconds." Previous feedback explicitly states the frozen metric is ms and the recorded observation is labeled seconds, and that silent relabeling or manufactured conversion records are not permitted. No documented unit conversion record exists in the supplied evidence — the unit mismatch between the recorded observation (seconds) and the claim metric (ms) is unresolved. Without a reconciled/versioned conversion of the existing evidence, the match cannot be confirmed. No controller_numeric_check is present. Coverage is therefore incomplete, and the assessment must be inconclusive.
